advisory_headline.tr: Vanuatu genel olarak son derece güvenlidir; Tanna'daki Yasur Dağı gibi aktif volkanlarda resmi güvenlik uyarıları takip edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Vanuatu is peaceful and safe; heed official alert bulletins near active volcanoes such as Mount Yasur.
advisory_headline.de: Vanuatu ist ein sicheres Reiseziel; Warnstufen bei aktiven Vulkanen (Mount Yasur) beachten.
advisory_headline.ru: Вануату спокойно и безопасно; следите за оповещениями сейсмических служб у вулкана Ясур.
advisory_headline.es: Vanuatu es pacífico y seguro; atienda los boletines de alerta en volcanes activos como el Monte Yasur.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Vanuatu reach approximately 26.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 42.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Vodafone Vanuatu and Digicel provide prepaid 4G SIMs at Bauerfield International Airport (VLI) in Port Vila. Domestic flights (Air Vanuatu) link Efate with Tanna and Espiritu Santo.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid SIM card registration requires passport identification

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 83%, predominantly Presbyterian, Anglican, and Roman Catholic) alongside traditional kastom beliefs
religion.evidence_quote: Christian worship is woven with ancient kastom laws and indigenous Melanesian traditions

festivals.value: Nagol Land Diving (Pentecost Island precursor to bungee jumping from April to June), Toka Festival on Tanna, Fest'Napuan music fest
festivals.evidence_quote: Naghol land diving on Pentecost Island is a world-renowned rite of passage and yam harvest ritual

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Respect kastom areas and sacred tabu stones; entering private tribal lands without local permission is forbidden. Tipping and bargaining are contrary to Melanesian kastom values and are not practiced anywhere in Vanuatu. Bislama, English, and French are official.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Tipping and haggling are not part of Vanuatu custom and are discouraged

tipping.value: Tipping is contrary to Melanesian culture and is not practiced. Exceptional gratitude is best expressed with a sincere smile and verbal thank you ('Tankyu tumas').
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping is not customary in Vanuatu and should not be offered
